---
name: issue-investigation
description: Investigate a reproducible issue, regression, failing check, or difficult defect and produce evidence, root cause, acceptance criteria, and a scoped fix.
---

Search for duplicates and collect versions, environment, reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, sanitized logs, configuration, and recent changes.

Reproduce when practical. Trace the affected call and data paths. Separate facts from hypotheses and record attempted fixes.

Define measurable acceptance criteria and regression checks. Implement only authorized scope. Close the issue only after the fix merges and all required verification passes.
